scripts.build:base: tsc -b packages/core packages/stdio && npm run bundle:stdio
scripts.test:base: npm run build:base && vitest run packages/core packages/stdio
scripts.test:server: npm run build:server && vitest run packages/server tests/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.integration.json && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.server-tests.json
scripts.typecheck:base: tsc -b packages/core packages/stdio --pretty false && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.integration.json
